question: By what factor does the viscosity of neat [TEPAH][ATA] before absorption exceed that of the [TEPAH][ATA]/NPA/H2O system before absorption?
rendered:
Table 1 on page 3 shows that the viscosity of neat [TEPAH][ATA] before absorption is 14.62 mPa s, and the viscosity of the [TEPAH][ATA]/NPA/H2O system before absorption is 2.33 mPa s. 

To find the factor by which the viscosity of neat [TEPAH][ATA] exceeds that of the [TEPAH][ATA]/NPA/H2O system, divide the viscosity of neat [TEPAH][ATA] by the viscosity of the [TEPAH][ATA]/NPA/H2O system:

14.62 mPa s / 2.33 mPa s = 6.27

The viscosity of neat [TEPAH][ATA] before absorption exceeds that of the [TEPAH][ATA]/NPA/H2O system before absorption by a factor of 6.27.
